title: Are the bridge margins automatic at finite Ds optima?
statement: Determine whether global/exchange-stable finite Ds optima under light-tailed atomless laws asymptotically satisfy the DS14 margins (cell mass, conditioning, projected-centroid separation), whether the margin-compatible geometric optimum equals the unrestricted population supremum, and how efficient-score-domination equality behaves at optima. Measured: singleton cells persist at exact global optima through N=18 and one exact degenerate tie exists (N-DS-BRIDGE-TREND).
